# Provider contract fixtures

[Test directory](../README.md) · [Project overview](../../README.md)

The [provider-contract directory](provider-contracts/README.md) contains selected Azure, Google Cloud and RunPod API-schema excerpts with upstream attribution. They let tests inspect request fields without contacting a cloud account.

Use the [provider compatibility checklist](../../docs/verification.md#provider-compatibility-checks) to qualify actual account behavior. Consult [runtime compatibility](../../docs/compatibility-and-upgrades.md) when upstream APIs change and preserve the source revision associated with each fixture.
